ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Primary_Termination_Reason__c , NOT( ISNEW() ) , NOT( ISCHANGED( NSP_Total_Payroll_Employees__c ) ) , NOT( ISCHANGED( NSP_Group_Member_Count__c ) ) , OR( ISBLANK( TEXT( Primary_Term_Reason__c ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Sub_Term_Reason__c ) ) , ( LEN( Termination_Key_Points__c ) = 0 ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Eligible_To_Return_To_Insperity_At_Time__c ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Termination_Anticipated__c ) ) , ( LEN( Why_Why_Not__c ) = 0 ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Did_Client_Go_To_A_Competitor__c ) ) , AND( ISPICKVAL( Did_Client_Go_To_A_Competitor__c , "Yes" ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Was_A_Bid_Obtained_For_Review__c ) ) ) , AND( ISPICKVAL( Did_Client_Go_To_A_Competitor__c , "Yes" ) , ISPICKVAL( Was_A_Bid_Obtained_For_Review__c , "Yes" ) , ( LEN( What_Was_The_Cost_Savings__c ) = 0 ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Leader_Involvement_In_Save_Attempt__c ) ) , AND( ISPICKVAL( Leader_Involvement_In_Save_Attempt__c , "Yes" ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( What_Level_Leader__c ) ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Was_Revolution_With_IIS_An_Option__c ) ) , AND( NOT( ISBLANK( TEXT( Was_Revolution_With_IIS_An_Option__c ) ) ), ( LEN( Why_Why_Not_An_Option__c ) = 0 ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must complete the Termination Information section when an Asset linked to the primary Account in the Renewal Probability Account Group has 'Written Termination Notice Received' selected.
